question: Avopure avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
AvoPure is an avocado oil brand owned and operated by
AVO PURE Limited
(also associated with
⁠Grove Avocado Oil
), based in the Bay of Plenty region of New Zealand. It is an independent regional producer specializing in cold-pressed Hass avocado oils rather than a subsidiary of a major multinational conglomerate.
Ownership Details
Parent Company:
AVO PURE Limited
Location:
Bay of Plenty, New Zealand
Core Focus:
Premium extra virgin and flavored culinary avocado oils sourced from local New Zealand orchards.
